    m.addConstr(-3.42 * vars['Var_0'] + 1.26 * vars['Var_2'] + -3.11 * vars['Var_3'] + 3.95 * vars['Var_5'] + -4.34 * vars['Var_6'] + 6.96 * vars['Var_8'] <= 26.29, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(0.42 * vars['Var_1'] + 0.04 * vars['Var_2'] + -2.17 * vars['Var_4'] + 8.18 * vars['Var_6'] + 0.02 * vars['Var_8'] <= 2.21, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(3.52 * vars['Var_0'] + -3.07 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.27 * vars['Var_3'] + 0.54 * vars['Var_4'] + 2.45 * vars['Var_5'] + 3.93 * vars['Var_7'] + 5.51 * vars['Var_8'] <= 32.84, name='C6')
